name: Build Contract
purpose: Turn pinned Requirements, Architecture, Current Context, System Map, and Effective Policy into a human-approved implementation contract and dependency-safe Bolt DAG without creating or executing implementation or test code.
completion_criteria: Every pinned requirement is assessed exactly once for build impact.

Every impacted requirement is covered by a change contract, every constraint or invariant has an acceptance criterion, every acceptance criterion has a verifier, and every change contract belongs to exactly one Bolt.

Core validates Bolt references, acyclicity, cross-Bolt dependencies, parallel target conflicts, repository boundaries, exact verifier argv/cwd/timeout/machine assertions, and policy constraints, then derives execution batches from the DAG.
Core creates an escaped static HTML review that shows exact targets and verifier execution details from the canonical candidate, then waits for one human approval bound to its SHA-256.
Execute creates a new immutable Build Contract revision, reuse pins an exact compatible approved revision, and not applicable is accepted only when all requirements have build_impact=false.
After approval Core records Current, Plan, Audit, and State and advances only through the fixed ST-05 to ST-06 Graph edge.
stop_conditions: A pinned input, Work Request, candidate, approval, current pointer, Plan, Core State, or immutable revision is missing, malformed, tampered, stale, or inconsistent.
Requirement traceability has a gap, orphan, duplicate, dangling reference, or an unapproved machine-verification exception.
The Bolt graph has a cycle, dangling dependency, missing contract dependency, or parallel target-path conflict.
A command verifier is a shell string, has unsafe argv or cwd, crosses its repository boundary, contains credentials, or would be executed during ST-05.
The human requests revision, the candidate SHA-256 differs from the pending review, or Core cannot persist the approval atomically.
